messages:
Jae (PM): quick one: when users save per-route views, can we show a tiny "estimate band" for cost + p50 latency? just a compact hint, not a full report.
Lina (Console): yep. think: small pill "~2.4k tokens / ~120ms" next to Save, click expands to a 3-line breakdown.
Omar (Backend): need API: POST /v1/estimates {filters, max_models:3}. returns compact vector. We'll compute from last-24h aggregates.
Priya (SRE): make sure we don't explode telemetry. Use pre-aggregated histograms and a 1% default sample. allow a short sample-bump when user requests an explicit refresh.
Lina (Console): UX: show a clock icon when band is stale >12h and a refresh button that queues an async job. show spinner; update when ready.
Jae (PM): rollout: feature-flag + opt-in. metric to monitor: estimate-accuracy (24h), and extra telemetry bytes.
Omar (Backend): implementation note: cache estimate per saved-view id for 6h, background worker to refresh. rate-limit per-org to 1 request / min.
estimate-bot: Estimate job queued: job-444 -> org:atlas-corp
Priya (SRE): agree on min retention for aggregated vectors (7d) and no raw traces persisted.
Lina (Console): I'll mock and link PRs. keeping pill terse helps adoption.
Omar (Backend): will open RFC with sample payload and simple cost calc fn.
estimate-bot: job-444 finished: success, samples: 812, confidence: 78%
